description: This file contains shell functions related to creating tar archive members. It includes functions to print tar headers with correct padding, add files to a tar archive with specific metadata, and add a trailer for the archive. The code appears aimed at constructing tar files manually via shell scripting, likely for custom packaging or archiving processes.

methods.name: __tar_print_padding
methods.description: Outputs padding bytes (zeros) to align tar headers and data to 512-byte blocks.

methods.name: tar_print_member
methods.description: Creates a tar archive member header with the specified filename and content, including necessary padding and metadata.

methods.name: tar_print_trailer
methods.description: Outputs padding to signify the end of the tar archive.
